meta_patterns.description: Independent physical, climatic, and neural systems exhibit irreversible forward-time trajectories when driven out of equilibrium.
Breakthroughs occur at boundaries, not in bulk: 0.42nm AlOx buffer, graphite-epoxy plate, Clavina modularity, vacuum birefringence.
Systems preserve target observables by redirecting into orthogonal degrees of freedom before environmental decoherence.
Early-universe high-complexity configurations survive late-time scrambling: tidal torque, glueballs, supermassive star cocoons.
Recurring C9 signature: subdominant CDW emerges after dominant mode perturbation; Mn-QDs suppress fast thermalization; sunlight SPDC suppresses coherence requirements.

meta_patterns.pattern_name: Generative Write-Back: From Prediction to Creation
meta_patterns.description: AI crosses from prediction to generative creation of functional entities: Evo 2 writes viable viruses, Clavina generates GKP states, 0.42nm interface engineers materials.

entries.title: Accelerating Wave Equation and Microscopic Arrow of Time
entries.key_claim: Wave speed variation introduces acceleration term yielding time-asymmetric solutions; resolves Abraham-Minkowski controversy via wave proper-time frame.

entries.title: 0.42nm Epitaxial Interface for Atomically Thin Transistors
entries.key_claim: Ultrathin epitaxial Al buffer (0.42nm) on CVD MoS2 enables EOT ~1nm with 0.45 mS/μm transconductance; wafer-scale 2D electronics viable.

entries.title: First Limits on Dark Matter Decay to Gravitons via Cosmic Filaments
entries.source: Physical Review D (Dunsky et al, NYU)
entries.key_claim: Gertsenshtein effect in cosmic filaments sets first constraints on DM→graviton decay; no exotic physics beyond graviton hypothesis needed.
entries.testability: Future: Advanced Particle-astrophysics Telescope (APT) could sharpen 10×

entries.title: Mn-Doped Quantum Dots Bypass Hot-Electron Thermalization
entries.key_claim: Magnetic Mn dopants capture hot electrons via fs magnetic interaction, redirecting energy before thermalization; enables photocatalysis under previously inaccessible barriers.
entries.evidence_strength: Femtosecond transient absorption + methyl viologen reduction assay
entries.testability: Immediate: extend to other magnetic dopants; solar fuel applications

entries.title: Sunlight-Driven Quantum Entanglement via SPDC
entries.key_claim: Highly incoherent sunlight generates polarization-entangled photons at 94% Bell-state fidelity; coherence in one DOF sufficient for entanglement in another.
entries.evidence_strength: Outdoor experiment + quantum state tomography + Bell violation
entries.testability: Immediate: field-deployable satellite QKD without onboard lasers

entries.title: Clavina: Extensible Universal Photonic Quantum Computing
entries.key_claim: Modular photonic architecture combining linear and nonlinear ops; deterministic GKP state generation; Bose-Hubbard simulation demonstrated.
entries.evidence_strength: Experimental demonstration of two applications + architectural scalability
entries.testability: Immediate: integrate additional nonlinear modules; error-correction threshold testing

entries.title: Primordial Tidal Torque Imprint in Galaxy Spins
entries.source: Nature Astronomy (Sheng et al, Xiamen U.)
entries.key_claim: ELUCID reconstruction + SAMI spin measurements confirm gas in massive ellipticals retains primordial tidal torque signal; strongest evidence for tidal torque theory.
entries.testability: Immediate: neutrino mass constraints from tidal field statistics; JWST high-z validation

entries.title: Statistically Significant Acceleration of Global Warming
entries.key_claim: After filtering ENSO/volcanic/solar noise, warming rate shifted from ~0.2°C/decade (1970-2015) to ~0.35°C/decade since ~2015; >98% statistical certainty across 5 datasets.
entries.evidence_strength: Meta-analysis of 5 global temperature records + 2 independent statistical methods
entries.testability: Immediate: attribution studies needed; policy window closing before 2030 1.5°C exceedance

entries.title: Levitated Magnet Magnetometer (LeMaMa) at Room Temperature
entries.source: Science (Ji et al, Peking U. / JGU Mainz)
entries.key_claim: Floating permanent magnet in ambient conditions achieves 32 fT/√Hz; graphite-epoxy bound plate reduces Johnson noise >70%; no cryogenics or shielding.
entries.testability: Immediate: MEG brain imaging; dark matter axion detection; fundamental physics

entries.title: Distinct Mechanisms for Competing Charge Density Waves
entries.key_claim: Erbium tritelluride: dominant CDW recovers via 2nd-order (continuous) transition; subdominant CDW recovers via 1st-order (nucleation/growth) transition—like water-to-ice.
entries.evidence_strength: Pump-probe ARPES at -230°C with controlled perturbation amplitude

entries.title: Two-Stage Neural Dynamics of Visual Consciousness
entries.key_claim: SQM illusion reveals unconscious encoding stage (~200ms, occipital) and conscious integration stage (~450ms, parietal); postdiction operates between stages.
entries.evidence_strength: EEG + ML decoding on 18 participants; reproducible across stimulus conditions
entries.testability: Immediate: TMS/perturbation to test causal role of 450ms signal; clinical (DOC patients)

entries.title: Glueball-Dominated Particle X(2370) Confirmed
entries.key_claim: 15-year campaign confirms X(2370) as flavor-singlet, glueball-dominated (~2.37 GeV); completes major Standard Model prediction.
entries.evidence_strength: BESIII: mass, quantum numbers, flavor-singlet signature; independent theoretical confirmation
entries.testability: Immediate: LHCb cross-check; lattice QCD refinement; search for pure glueballs

entries.title: Little Red Dots as Supermassive Progenitor Stars
entries.key_claim: 10^5 M⊙ supermassive stars with 'strange-mode' pulsations create dense cocoons explaining JWST compact morphology; direct-collapse SMBH seeds.
entries.evidence_strength: Stellar evolution models + JWST photometric consistency; nitrogen-rich outflows detected
entries.testability: Near-term: JWST spectroscopic confirmation of predicted N/He ratios

entries.title: Vacuum Birefringence Observed in Magnetar 1E1547
entries.key_claim: X-ray polarization from magnetar aligns with magnetic pole rotation; strong-field QED prediction of Heisenberg (1930s) observed—vacuum itself modifies light propagation.
entries.testability: Immediate: repeat for other magnetars; laboratory analogs with strong laser fields

entries.title: Evo 2 Designs First Fully AI-Generated Viable Bacteriophages
entries.source: Science (King et al., Stanford / Arc Institute)
entries.key_claim: Evo 1/2 generated ~700k ΦX174-variant genomes; 285 synthesized, 16 viable phages confirmed by plaque assay and cryo-EM. Some outperformed natural phage against antibiotic-resistant E. coli.
entries.evidence_strength: Experimental synthesis + plaque assay + cryo-EM + efficacy comparison
entries.testability: Immediate: replicate with other scaffolds; scale to larger genomes; C9 biosafety scoring integration
